Write a generator function using yield.

Supplied answer
def my_generator():
    yield 1
    yield 2
    yield 3
for value in my_generator():
    print(value)
gen = my_generator()
print(next(gen)) # 1
print(next(gen)) # 2
Note: yield pauses the function and remembers where it stopped. return would end it.
